script.speaker: brooke
script.text: lunch crew, downtown edition! who's out at noon?

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: liam!! cyrus talks about you all the time, but this is our first actual lunch. hi!

script.speaker: liam
script.text: hi brooke! heard you're the one who keeps this chat alive. respect

script.speaker: liam
script.text: ok so i dreamed about thai food last night. a whole table of it. woke up starving. i need thai

script.speaker: maya
script.text: i would fight someone for thai right now. i'm in

script.speaker: liam
script.text: wait. thai. cyrus. are we okay after the satay incident??

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: We're okay. The assistant knows the drill by now.

script.speaker: maya
script.text: no bullet points?? cyrus are you feeling alright

script.speaker: cyrus
script.text: I'm fine. I'm learning to trust the process.

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: i'll still double check for you. no satay, no dipping sauce, nothing crushed on top of the noodles. same as always

script.speaker: maya
script.text: also, gentle reminder: the coast trip is coming up fast and the fund is not where it should be

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: the trip fund! how's it looking?

script.speaker: maya
script.text: tight. if lunch costs more than a few bucks, the trip fund cries. and then i cry

script.speaker: liam
script.text: cheap thai is the best thai anyway

script.speaker: brooke
script.text: count me in! climbing after work though, and the last time i had a fried lunch i didn't make it past the first hold

script.speaker: liam
script.text: assistant, please. i dreamed about thai and i need it to come true
